title: Hold the box
goal: Keep it hovering inside the box by hand for a minute in QLOITER, then a minute in QHOVER.

steps.text: Switch to QLOITER and keep it inside the box for 60 seconds with your controller.
steps.hint: In QLOITER it hovers and holds its place when you let go of the sticks. Nudge it back towards the middle.

steps.text: Now switch to QHOVER and keep it in for 60 seconds more.
steps.hint: In QHOVER it holds its height but drifts when you let go. Small, early corrections keep it in.

fails.says: Failed. Out of the box for 5 s.

passed: Passed. In the box in both modes.
